following:

ORDER Petitioner has filed this petition challenging the orders dated 25/10/2018 Annexure P-5 and 29/10/2018 Annexure P-6 passed by the Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue) and Land Acquisition Officer, Tehsil Raghurajnagar, District Satna and the Commissioner, Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation, Bansagar Project, Rewa.
Relief is sought to quash those orders Annexures P-5 and P-6.

In the alternate, it is prayed that respondent no. 2 be directed to consider and decide the petitioner's application under Section 33 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: This innocuous prayer is not opposed by Shri Subodh Kathar, learned Government Advocate.

Accordingly, this petition can be disposed of with a direction that in case, petitioner files a fresh representation before respondent no. 2 within fifteen days from today, the said authority shall consider and decide the petitioner's pending application within a further period of sixty days.
This court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
In above terms, the petition is disposed of.
